notes: Account background: Converge Works is a mid-market SaaS vendor building an embeddable in-app assistant for product teams. Heavy focus on agentic workflows that combine search -> decision -> action (create task, call webhook, update CRM). Looking to replace brittle homegrown orchestration with a hosted inference partner and potentially move to Dedicated for predictable throughput.
Initial interest: Strong starting signal for Hosted API to accelerate feature launch. Long-term interest in Dedicated for cost predictability and data isolation once usage hits steady state.

Key technical requirements: strict latency SLOs (target 95ms median, 250-300ms 99th for streaming token latency), streaming + incremental partial outputs, reliable tool-calling primitives (function/tool calls) with robust retry/fallback semantics, KV-caching for common prefixes, and observability on per-route token costs.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML) for admin console; KMS integration for key material; need EU data residency for a subset of customers. Legal reviewing retention policy doc (see drive link).

POC ask: 2-week Hosted API POC to validate streaming latency under production-like load (concurrent agents ~150), tool call end-to-end reliability with third-party search and downstream webhook actions, and failure modes (timeouts, partial results). We'll run canary scenario that does search -> reasoning -> tool call -> confirmation, measure end-to-end p95/p99 and success rate of tool actions.

Demo notes (2026-01-12): showed streaming + function calling demo. Client liked partial output streaming and the ability to abort and retry tool calls. SE Samira ran through routing/fallback story. AE highlighted Dedicated for predictable throughput and burst configs.
Quote from product lead: 'Need hard numbers on how function calls behave at scale - retries and timeouts kill UX.'

Commercials: asked for example Dedicated pricing for 2 reserved GPU instances + burst capacity; requested model/quantization guidance for agentic flows. Estimated ARR band discussed: $50k-$200k ARR if thresholds met.

POC success criteria: average streaming token latency within target; p99 end-to-end for agent flow under load below 350ms (negotiable); tool-call success rate >98% with graceful fallback to cached/approx response on downstream timeout; dashboarding of per-route costs and tracing for failed tool invocations.

Open technical questions: how KV caching interacts with streaming for long context agent loops; recommended batching settings for mixed short/long prompts; exact SLAs for function call timeout and backoff behavior.

Next steps owner assignments: AE (Alex) to schedule POC kickoff; SE (Samira) to provide test harness and suggested kernel/quantization model variants; engineering contact from Converge (Ivan Petrov) to provide webhook endpoints for integration.
